mapper.select: SELECT ct.cash_transaction_id, ct.account_id, ct.transaction_type, ct.amount, ct.balance_after, ct.memo, ct.transaction_at FROM cash_transaction ct JOIN account_link al ON al.account_id = ct.account_id WHERE al.member_id = #{memberId} ORDER BY ct.transaction_at DESC LIMIT 30
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cash_transaction(account_id, transaction_type, amount, balance_after, memo, transaction_at) VALUES(#{accountId}, #{transactionType}, #{amount}, #{balanceAfter}, #{memo}, #{transactionAt})
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ct.transaction_type = 'DEPOSIT' THEN ct.amount ELSE -ct.amount END), 0) FROM cash_transaction ct JOIN account_link al ON al.account_id = ct.account_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT asn.account_id, MAX(asn.snapshot_date) AS baseline_date FROM asset_snapshot asn WHERE asn.snapshot_date <= #{periodStart} GROUP BY asn.account_id ) baseline ON baseline.account_id = ct.account_id WHERE al.member_id = #{memberId} AND (baseline.baseline_date IS NULL OR DATE(ct.transaction_at) > baseline.baseline_date)
